Now I can see the bug clearly. At line 2993-2994, when `decodeFields` fails, `dst->data` is freed but `dst->type` is still set. The function returns `ret` (the error code) at line 3015. The caller (`Variant_decodeJson` at line 2742) then returns the error to `UA_decodeJson`, which calls `UA_deleteMembers(dst, type)` → `Variant_clear`. In `Variant_clear`, since `dst->data` is not NULL and `dst->type` is set, it tries to free the already-freed memory.

Now let me also check the other path at line 3009-3010 - same bug there too.
